name: Поліпшення позиції фігури (1)
description:
Once you have completed your development, the middlegame starts. If all your pieces are active, this does not automatically mean that you will win the game. In the middlegame you try to outwit your opponent through clever maneuvers. By playing a piece to an even better square, your pieces will improve their coordination. With strong coordination you can look for vulnerabilities in your opponent's position.

What do you have to do?

Play a piece to a better square. Look for vulnerabilities in the enemy camp or improve the coordination between your pieces.
